examples.description: Add a second b-roll track for a picture-in-picture over the first

description: Add an empty track of a role (video-broll, text, audio-music or audio-voice), up to 16 tracks in the project. The new track lands on top of its role: a video-broll or text track draws over the ones before it (picture-in-picture, a second title layer), an audio track mixes in beside the others. Place clips on it by passing the returned track_id to add_clip_to_timeline, add_audio_to_timeline or add_text_overlay. Refuses at the track cap, naming the fix.

name.description: A display name up to 40 characters; the role's label shows when left out.
